notes.ddp: Dense DDP assumes fp32 gradients synced every step, step time 30s. Bandwidth = params × 4B × 8b ÷ 30s.
notes.diloco: DiLoCo-style assumes full-precision fp32 pseudo-gradients synced over a 1200s (20-min) compute window.
notes.sparseloco: SparseLoCo curve anchored to Covenant-72B's measured 110 Mbps uplink at 72.7B params, scaled linearly. Top-k=64 per 4096-param chunk (1.56% density), 2-bit values, 12-bit indices → 146.3× compression vs fp32 dense.
notes.compressionDetail: Per chunk: 64 × (2+12) bits = 896 bits; dense fp32: 4096 × 32 bits = 131072 bits; ratio = 131072 / 896 = 146.3×
